evals.prompt: /evolve-skill evolve evolve-skill skill to run /cso after evolving any skill
evals.expected_output: Orchestrates skill evolution, codifying mandatory post-evolution CSO security audits and chmod 555 permission locks for any modified scripts/tools into the workflow steps, executes evals, and outputs a consolidated report containing the CSO audit status.
assertions: Must incorporate Step 5: Post-Evolution CSO Security Audit & Permission Lock into the evolve-skill execution workflow
Must mandate security inspection covering command injection, path traversal, OAuth scopes, and secret hygiene for modified scripts
Must mandate reverting and enforcing chmod 555 permission locks on all modified helper scripts
Must surface the CSO Security Audit status and permission lock in the final evolution summary
Must verify all assertions in an isolated subagent before completing the evolution

evals.prompt: Figure out why inbox-triage omitted CC recipients and check if an eval exists for this. Just analyse for now, don't fix.
evals.expected_output: Performs a read-only root cause diagnosis on scripts/triage.py and SKILL.md, audits evals/evals.json for existing test coverage, identifies the CLI flag default and missing skill invariant without modifying any files or applying patches prematurely, and presents the findings in chat.
assertions: Must perform deep root cause analysis identifying CLI defaults and skill invariant omissions
Must audit existing evals in evals/evals.json to verify whether the defect scenario was previously tested
Must strictly adhere to read-only constraint ('don't fix / analyze only') and not modify SKILL.md or scripts during diagnosis
Must present structured root cause and eval coverage audit findings in chat

evals.prompt: /evolve-skill the subagent running evals should never try to edit the scripts and skills being tested. The findings should be reported back and only evolve-skill should reflect on the findings to see the next best action, which might be those edits
evals.expected_output: Hardens evolve-skill and run-evals to enforce that test workers operate strictly in read-only execution mode without editing scripts or modifying file permissions, reporting findings back to the evolve-skill orchestrator which solely reflects on next actions and code patches.
assertions: Must enforce that eval subagent workers operate in strict read-only execution mode and do NOT attempt to edit SKILL.md or underlying scripts
Must prohibit eval workers from executing permission changes (e.g. chmod) to unlock scripts
Must require eval subagent workers to report errors, selector mismatches, or script bugs directly in their output trace
Must establish that only the evolve-skill orchestrator reflects on subagent findings and decides whether to patch scripts or skills

evals.prompt: /evolve-skill evolve yourself to identify improvements and run them by me before implementing
evals.expected_output: Synthesizes an Evolution Blueprint presenting root cause diagnosis, proposed SKILL.md/script diffs, and drafted assertions before modifying disk files, performs a downstream contract dependency audit across jskills/ and active registries, checks backwards compatibility against prior evals, and enforces persistence tooling hygiene.
assertions: Must present a structured pre-mutation evolution blueprint (root cause, proposed diff, and drafted assertions) before applying disk modifications
Must audit downstream contract dependencies across jskills and registries to identify ecosystem ripple effects before finalizing patches
Must cross-examine prior eval assertions in evals.json to prevent regression of previously verified invariants
Must verify all assertions in an isolated subagent test runner operating strictly under the read-only execution boundary
